title: Rust: migrate to tracing spans with structured fields
description: Rust gateway imports tracing (lichend.rs) but barely uses it — no spans, no structured fields. lichen-link imports log but usage is sparse. Migrate critical paths to tracing with spans: info_span!(rx_frame, packet_id, sender_iid, rssi) wrapping ingest, info_span!(tx_drain, queue_depth) wrapping TX. Node runtime (lichen-node) uses defmt on embedded and log/tracing on std via existing conditional compilation. Gives AI hierarchical trace of packet processing.
